instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Inside a judo dojo with blue and yellow mats, the young man with short dark hair and a black undershirt (R4) on the left and the middle-aged man (R3) on the right engage in a grapple. The young man (R4) wears a white judogi with black shoulder stripes and grips the middle-aged man's (R3) lapel. The middle-aged man (R3), wearing a white judogi, grips the young man's (R4) collar in return. Both look at each other with focused expressions under bright, even indoor lighting.
